summary: Backend-only regression of new POST /api/admin/cleanup-raw-uploads endpoint plus auto-cleanup code review. 7/7 pytest cases pass. Auth guard (no-token + free-user) blocked with 403. Response shape contains all 6 required keys with correct types. Idempotency verified — second call after main-agent's prior run reclaimed 0 bytes, 0 removals, 0 repoints. Safety verified — all 12 raw .mov files without a .web.mp4 sibling (the playable cases) are preserved on disk; recent admin reports still resolve via /api/reports/mine and /api/reports/{id}/status returns 200 with a valid status payload. Auto-cleanup block at server.py:3469-3478 inspected — uses try/except, exists() + resolve()-equality guard, best-effort logging on failure (no raise). Implementation matches spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 8263 lines — well past the 700-line target. Already flagged in earlier iterations; remains a maintenance risk but is out-of-scope for this session.
Cleanup endpoint correctly excludes mongo _id via projection `{'_id': 0, 'id': 1, 'video_filename': 1}` in both cursors — good.
Pass 3 only deletes raw .mov/.mp4 when a .web.mp4 sibling exists AND the report row is gone — this is the right safety bar; no risk of nuking the 12 playable-raw .mov files currently on disk.

Auto-cleanup-on-transcode at L3469-3478 uses raw_path.resolve() != web_path.resolve() guard — correctly defends against the fallback case where transcode_to_web_mp4 returns the same path as input (no double-delete).
Auto-cleanup is best-effort (logged warning on failure, not raised) which is the right call — transcode already succeeded, user-visible state is fine even if unlink fails.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing accounts and uploads dir state from previous session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cleanup endpoint is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_cleanup_endpoint.py (TestAuthGuard, TestCleanupBehaviour, TestPostCleanupSafety). Pre-existing uploads dir state: 12 raw .mov files (all without .web.mp4 sibling = playable), 4 .web.mp4 files, ~873 MB total. Idempotent — re-running the cleanup yields 0,0,0. If future changes touch L3450-3494 (auto-cleanup-on-transcode) or L7970-8098 (admin endpoint), re-run this test file.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature verification, no bug found.
